title: I'm making a cozy roguelike deckbuilder!
author: SproutAndSesame
selftext:
Here's **Arborist**!

Think of your favorite roguelike deckbuilders with lots of card variety and replayability, except instead of fighting monsters, you're building a garden beautiful enough to attract rare birds.

I'm a solo developer, and I've used AI across the game's art to help me make way more plants, birds, animals, and other assets than I could've managed on my own (550 images so far...).

I spent the past six months working on this and the Steam page just went live! [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5250680/Arborist/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5250680/Arborist/)

replies.author: SproutAndSesame
replies.body: I'm using godot. I found it really easy to work with agents. I've tried starting with unity before and it was overwhelming

replies.author: SproutAndSesame
replies.body: I see you're making a game too 🫡
